claims.text: The Namib Desert runs along Namibia's Atlantic coast and is famous for its tall red dunes.
The Kalahari lies inland, the Karoo is in South Africa and the Atacama is in Chile.
Cold ocean water off the Namibian coast helps keep the Namib almost rainless.
Fog from the Atlantic is an important source of water for beetles and plants in the Namib.
